source_text: De batillis Chore et seditione populi adversum Moysen et de virgis in quibus virga Aaron germinavit. Apud Deum nihil inutile, nihil otiosum. Batilla peccantium iubet Deus non abici sed fieri laminas ductiles atque altare circumdari in commemorationem, ut non accedat alienigena qui non est de semine Aaron.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning censers of-Korah and sedition of-people against Moses and concerning rods in which rod of-Aaron sprouted. With God nothing useless, nothing idle. Censers of-sinners orders God not to-be-cast-away but to-be-made plates beaten and altar to-be-surrounded unto remembrance, that not may-approach foreigner who not is from seed of-Aaron.
pass_b_english: On [[Korah’s censers >> Bible:Numbers 16:36-40]], the people’s sedition against Moses, and the rods among which [[Aaron’s rod budded >> Bible:Numbers 17:8]]. With God nothing is useless or idle. He orders the sinners’ censers not thrown away but beaten into plating for the altar — a memorial that no outsider not of Aaron’s seed may draw near.
